user.title: Monochrome
user.description: Installs four retro monochrome-monitor themes (Green, Amber, Paperblack, Paperwhite) and their effects. After setup pick a theme in your profile.

init.title: Monochrome effects
init.description: Changes apply after reloading the browser page (Ctrl+F5).

abort.yaml_managed: Effect options are set in configuration.yaml (monochrome:). Edit them there and restart Home Assistant.

glitch.name: Glitch
glitch.description: Run a glitch effect on every open Home Assistant tab that uses a Monochrome theme.

intensity.name: Intensity
intensity.description: 1 (subtle) to 10 (heavy): number of distorted strips and how far they shift.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: How long the glitch lasts, in seconds.
